text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: INC-175500 - high 5xx rate detected for inference-gateway-eu. Alerting on >50 rps 5xx over 2m. Metric link: https://metrics.redwood/inference/eu/5xx (auto-generated)

pagerduty: auto-ack by alice (on-call) :white_check_mark:

alice: I'm taking this. Opening bridge and grabbing impact. pinging SREs.

ben: seeing the same. 5xx burst started at ~2026-03-15T13:02:10Z (approx). Backend logs show connection resets to local model-runtime process. Not all requests, but spike to ~12% 5xx on gateway.

carla: joining bridge — https://meet.redwood/bridge/INC-175500 — I can take ownership if alice wants to handoff.

alice: handing to carla for mitigation. quick status: customers in EU seeing degraded completions / 502s, some timeouts. Auto-scaling didn't drain fast enough.

dan: digging into routing. hypothesis: a canary rollout to model-variant v2.3.1 overloaded a subset of inference pods causing upstream resets. I can temporarily route traffic to us-west pool. quick command to change route:```bash
# devops CLI (prod)
rwdctl routing adjust --from-region eu --to-region us-west --weight 1 --policy immediate
```

ben: logs snippet from gateway (truncated):```
[13:02:12] ERROR inference-gateway: upstream reset by peer (model-proxy-12) request_id=abcd1234
[13:02:12] WARN queue-manager: inflight_requests=240, max=200
[13:02:13] ERROR model-proxy-12: oom-kill? killed process pid=3245
```

carla: rolling back the canary now. using k8s rollback to previous replica set.```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/model-runtime --to-revision=12
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/model-runtime --replicas=60
```

alice: thanks. also enabling fallback policy to route to quantized-compat variant for low-latency small payloads:```json
{"route_policy":"fallback","variants":["quantized-v1","stable-v2"]}```

michael: adding cache clear on kv-cache to avoid replaying bad prefixes:```bash
rwdctl cache purge --scope prefix --matcher "session-*" --region eu
```

dan: applied regional routing change. pinging loadgen: traffic shift ~70% to us-west within 30s.

pagerduty: escalation notice - auto-escalated to infra-leads at 13:07 UTC (no manual ack from secondary).

carla: monitoring metrics... 5xx rate falling from 12% -> 2.3% over 4m. latency improving. I'm going to keep the rollback in place for 30m and let autoscaler replenish.

eve-sre: noted customer impact: approx 19k requests affected in EU window, ~3% of global traffic. CS notified top 10 customers and posted status.redwood.com incident note.

ben: also observed queue depth spike on embeddings-workers in same window; might be downstream effect. created ticket #ENG-5421 to follow up.

alice: status ping @channel - are we comfortable moving to reduced-severity? current 5xx <1% for last 3m, no new oom events.

carla: +1. I'll continue to monitor and if stable for 15m we'll close the page. prepping RCA draft (link to doc: https://docs.redwood/rca/INC-175500-draft).

dan: follow-up action items: 1) add preflight CPU/memory headroom check to model rollouts; 2) tune autoscaler cooldown; 3) add route fallback tests to canary pipeline.

alice: marking action-owner: dan for rollout checks, ben for downstream queue analysis, carla for RCA and customer comms.

incident-bot: Incident INC-175500 status changed -> monitoring (owner: carla).

michael: final check - 5xx at 0.4% last 5m, p95 latency back to baseline.

eve-sre: closing plan: if stable 15m -> resolve PD, otherwise escalate. I'll keep CS updated.

carla: closing page in 16m if stable. thanks everyone for quick response. :heart:

pagerduty: INCIDENT INC-175500 resolved by carla at 2026-03-15T13:24:10Z — root cause: canary model variant overloaded small subset of nodes plus insufficient autoscaler headroom. Postmortem created: https://docs.redwood/rca/INC-175500-final

alice: added retrospective note to sprint. good job all.

ben: thumbs up. :thumbsup:

# end of thread
